actions.action: Check top inch of soil with finger before watering
Water thoroughly until it drains, then empty saucer after 15-30 minutes
If soil is hydrophobic, bottom-water by soaking pot for 20-30 minutes
Move plant to bright indirect light near an east or south window
Trim leggy stems back by a third and cut off dead crispy parts
Root cuttings in water or press into soil and replant in pot
Make sure pot has drainage holes
Check stems near soil for mushiness, blackening or smell to rule out overwatering

reason: The answer correctly identifies low light and suggests rooting cuttings in the soil, but it names underwatering as the main cause instead of overwatering, so the diagnosis and advice are partial; the finger-check safeguard keeps the watering advice from being harmful.
